messages.content: 誰是目前排名第一的網球選手？

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have real‑time access to live sports databases, so I can’t tell you who holds the World No. 1 spot on the ATP or WTA tour right now.  
For the most up‑to‑date information you should:

| Tour | Where to look |
|------|---------------|
| **ATP** (men’s singles) | [Official ATP Rankings](https://www.atptour.com/en/rankings/singles) – updated weekly (usually Monday). |
| **WTA** (women’s singles) | [Official WTA Rankings](https://www.wtatennis.com/rankings/) – also updated each week. |

These pages list the full leaderboard along with points earned over the past 52 weeks, so you’ll see exactly who sits at rank 1 today.
